A Pune studio that travels everywhere.

Avi Photography is run by Avi from Pune. What began with a love for capturing people at their happiest has grown into a studio that covers weddings, pre-wedding films, maternity shoots, baby showers, birthdays, events and cinematic reels.

We shoot in a natural, story-first way. You will not spend hours in stiff poses. We guide you gently, catch the in-between moments, and then edit them with care so the colours and emotions look the way you remember them.

Our studio is near Prayas Public School, Barge Wasti Road, Chimbali gaon, Pune. For destination shoots we simply pack up and come to you, anywhere in India.

Common questions

Do you travel outside Pune?

Yes. We shoot all over India. Travel and stay costs are discussed before you confirm.

How do we book a date?

Message us on WhatsApp or call 9545112549 with your date and location. We'll confirm availability and share the booking steps.

Do I get the raw files?

The Pre-Wedding Silver package includes all raw data and original files. For other shoots, please ask when you inquire.

Can I customise a package?

Of course. Birthdays, reels, events and commercial shoots are quoted around your needs, and wedding packages can be adjusted too.

How will I receive my photos and videos?

Through a digital cloud gallery, so you can view and download them from any device.
